name: 葉宗軒
objective:
本課程將訓練學生運用電腦 2D 與 3D 軟體進行視覺轉譯與創意提案。
課程強調實作與思考並重：學生將透過操作練習建立數位軟體能力，並透過研究方法與品牌策略的訓練，培養從構想到完整提案的敘事與轉譯能力。
This course trains students to use 2D and 3D computer software for visual translation and creative proposal development. The course emphasizes both hands-on practice and critical thinking: students will build digital software skills through practical exercises, while developing narrative and translation abilities—from concept to complete proposal—through training in research methods and brand strategy.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 01 課程導論 | Course Introduction
Week 02 圖像美學歷史與發展 1 | History and Development of Graphic Aesthetics I
Week 03 圖像美學歷史與發展 2 | History and Development of Graphic Aesthetics II
Week 04 軟體實作與簡報練習 | Software Practice and Presentation Exercise
Week 05 電腦繪圖基礎 (向量繪圖基礎操作) | Computer Graphics Fundamentals 
Week 06 簡報實作報告 | Presentation Practice & Report
Week 07 拼貼實作 | Collage Practice
Week 08 Logo 初體驗 | Introduction to Logo Design
Week 08 創意工作坊 1 (團隊組成／研究方法工作坊) | Creative Workshop 1
Week 09 創意工作坊 2 (研究方法工作坊) | Creative Workshop 2 
Week 10 商品研究與洞察整理 | Product Research and Insight Synthesis
Week 11 品牌價值與品牌故事 | Brand Values and Brand Storytelling
Week 12 情緒版與顏色思考 | Mood Boards and Color Thinking
Week 13 3D 工具實作 | Introduction to 3D Tools
Week 14 空間與造型 | Spatial and Form Design
Week 15 期末提案工作坊 | Final Proposal Workshop
Week 16 期末發表：文化商品品牌提案 | Final Presentation: Cultural Product Branding Proposal
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Week 17 軟體工具整合實作
Flexible Learning: Integrated Software Production
學生利用彈性週，將課程所學之 2D／3D 軟體串聯運用，把團隊已完成之品牌視覺系統延伸應用於新的商品或素材產出，完整走過一次個人獨立操作的軟體整合流程。

Week 18 彈性學習：軟體成果線上展示與同儕互評
Flexible Learning: Online Software Portfolio Showcase and Peer Review
學生於線上平臺展示個人軟體整合實作成果，透過跨組瀏覽與同儕互評，觀摩不同詮釋方式。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          2
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          繳交專題成果作品以及學習心得。

學生於線上平臺展示個人軟體整合實作成果，透過跨組瀏覽與同儕互評，觀摩不同詮釋方式，為整體課程學習做一次非正式的統整與收尾。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          討論 (50 %)    
報告 (50 %)

延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
